title: Stale reset contracts are rejected before execution
blocker: The reference evaluator rejects stale reset fact envelopes, but there is no production reset provider or pre-execution re-query bound to the active publisher snapshot, lease and live ownership context.
assertions: inventory epoch, topology hash, reset rule version and affected-set provenance are all bound into the selected reset contract
a change in any bound value makes the old contract unselectable and unexecutable
the provider re-queries the affected set after ownership preparation and immediately before reset
unknown or expanded affected sets retain the whole bundle claim and fail closed
